title: CMA-ES over the eighteen fair-leaf weights inside the fast depth-4 five-stratum search, fresh training seeds per generation, one held-out paired screen
hypothesis: Starting from the frozen vector in sign-normalised coordinates (sigma0 = 0.25 relative), a (8/8_w, 16)-CMA-ES with mirrored sampling whose fitness is the mean score of 32 complete depth-4 five-stratum games on a fresh contiguous block of the training lease per generation (the frozen vector played on every block as a control) produces, after at most 40 generations, a distribution mean whose 64-game held-out paired delta against the frozen leaf passes the gate below. Tuning and deployment use the same search: the bit-exact fast engine (finding-13) with the leaf weights as data, depth 4, five strata, cache 60,000, worst-case-bound work, terminal utility -1,000,000, policy seed 0xd7075eed.

data.reuseDisclosure: CHECK gates read previously opened development probe seeds 0xa5278000-0xa52784ff (leaf-reweight CHECK probes) and the PILOT read the first 16 seeds of the already-opened shared evaluation cohort 0xa51d1000 (runtime projection and exact-reproduction check only; no strength claim). Training uses the new lease 0xa5290000+ in contiguous 32-seed blocks, one block per generation, never replayed. The held-out screen uses the new, never-read lease 0xa52b0000-0xa52b003f, which is disjoint from every training block and from every range in docs/exploratory/lease-map.md. The 7-stratum transfer arm replays the same held-out seeds and is a secondary diagnostic on already-read data.

metrics.primary: paired mean whole-game score delta, candidate minus frozen leaf, depth 4 five strata, 64 held-out games
secondary: numbered clears per move and cover reveals per move
first-half and second-half paired mean deltas (seeds 0-31 and 32-63)
paired population-mean-minus-control trajectory over generations (training blocks, monitoring only)
secondary transfer: paired delta of the same candidate at depth 4 seven strata on the same held-out seeds (diagnostic)
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: one-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over whole games, 20,000 resamples, RNG seed 0xb0071eaf (compare.py), plus a one-sided 95% Student-t lower bound; detection floor 1.645*sd/sqrt(n) reported

passCriteria: All CHECK gates passed before the first training seed was read: leaf bit-identity (0 mismatches), search parity with FastSearch (0 action/work/node/cache/depth mismatches), determinism across 1 and N threads, reflection, metadata blindness, completed depth and legality under perturbed weights.
Every generation artifact and the screen artifact have incompleteDecisionsTotal 0, illegalDecisionsTotal 0 and no score-identity failures.
Held-out screen, depth 4 five strata, 64 paired games on 0xa52b0000-0xa52b003f: bootstrap 95% lower bound of the paired score delta > 0 AND Student-t 95% lower bound > 0.
Held-out screen: candidate lower-quartile score >= frozen lower-quartile score.
Held-out screen: paired mean score delta > 0 in both halves (seeds 0-31 and 32-63).
The candidate evaluated is the CMA distribution mean written to candidate-weights.txt before the held-out lease is opened; no other vector is screened.
gate.failureAction: Record a valid run with scientific outcome fail for this exact configuration (optimiser, budget, depth, strata, fitness); do not adopt the vector; report the 7-stratum transfer arm as diagnostic only; open no further cohort for this candidate.
gate.passAction: Freeze candidate-weights.txt with its SHA-256; register a fresh-block replication by a different runner and a seven-stratum-native evolution as successor experiments; do not open protected or final seeds.

stopConditions: Stop on any rules, information-boundary, legality, determinism, or parity failure.

Evolution stops at 40 generations, at 14 wall-hours, when sigma < 0.02, when the training lease is exhausted, or when a STOP file appears in the run directory; the candidate is the distribution mean at the last completed generation in every case.
A generation artifact with incomplete decisions voids the run (invalid), not the candidate.
The screen is evaluated exactly once; no re-run on the same or a different held-out block without a new experiment record.
expectedArtifacts: runs/<evolution-run-id>/config.json, progress.jsonl, cma-state.json, gen-NNN/population.{txt,json}, candidate-weights.txt, final.json
runs/<screen-run-id>/heldout-d4s5.json and heldout-d4s7.json (population artifacts with frozen and candidate on 0xa52b0000+64)
